A very large numeric value (e.g., 3600) would still pass the check, and the loop sleeps between attempts twice, so the job can be held for hours on a transient API error and exhaust the step / job budget before reaching `marker_failed`.
  WHY: Suggested minimal fix: Add an upper bound check immediately after the digit check and fall back to 5 when exceeded, for example `[ "${retry_sleep}" -le 60 ] || retry_sleep=5`.
